_comment: One entry per coverage row of references/coverage/**/*.md whose note has a `cora-issue —` part, keyed by coverage file (group/class) and method as printed in the row (without backticks). `description`: at most ten words on what CORA gets wrong, from the row's `cora-issue —` text; LaTeX-escaped by the generator except inside $...$. `kind`: `unsound` when CORA's result can miss reachable states, is not the enclosure it claims to be, or is a wrong verdict a verification relies on; `other` for a bug that is too large, a wrong flag, a crash or error path, or a documented behaviour that is not the code's. Optional `cex` / `fix`: name of a Lean file (or its repository path) the row links, in its third column or its note, replacing the default pick. Read by scripts/paper/cora-bugs-table.py for experiments/paper/latex/appendix-cora-bugs.tex; scripts/formalization-stats.py --check fails on a missing or orphaned entry, and scripts/check-findings.py checks that the entry names a row that exists. `matlab`: the outcome of running the bug in MATLAB R2024b with CORA v2026.1.0 (904a444), one of `confirmed`, `partly confirmed`, `not reproduced`, `not run`; the observed output stands in the row's Details paragraph and in experiments/cora-bugs/results.tsv. It is not shown in the table.
